roleGate.heading: Wrong persona
roleGate.body: You are signed in as {{role}}. Sign in as Anjali to acknowledge an incident.

submitted.subtitle: Recorded on the chain.
submitted.approveBody: Thank you. The operator will seal the incident as resolved on the chain.
submitted.disputeBody: Thank you. The operator will reopen the incident for review.

expired.heading: This report is closed. You can reopen within 30 days.
expired.body: The 24-hour acknowledgement window passed at {{time}}. The operator's fix is now sealed on the chain.
expired.reopenHint: If the issue is still present, request a reopen below. After 30 days the report is permanently closed.

permanent.heading: This report is permanently closed ⚠︎
permanent.body: The 30-day reopen window has closed. The report is now read-only on the chain.

form.subtitle: {{name}} · incident {{id}} · ward {{ward}} · see inbox detail
form.noticeMetaNone: No notice was sent. You can still respond to the operator.
form.noticeFallback: The operator confirmed the fix for incident {{id}}.
form.decisionHeading: Did the fix resolve the issue?
form.decisionBody: Confirm to close the incident. Reopen to dispute it for review.

reopen.heading: Reopen the report
reopen.body: Tell the operator what is still wrong. The reason is sealed on the chain alongside the reopen action.
reopen.reasonLabel: Why is the fix not enough?
reopen.reasonPlaceholder: Describe what is still wrong. Minimum 200 characters, maximum 400.
reopen.minHint: At least {{min}} characters; up to {{max}} ({{count}} typed).
